connectorUiConfig.title: Squadra Technologies secRMM (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Use the Squadra Technologies [secRMM](https://www.squadratechnologies.com/Products/secRMM/secRMMOverview.aspx) data connector to push USB removable storage security event data into Microsoft Sentinel. secRMM sends events to the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API, using the Data Collection Rule and Microsoft Entra application that this connector deploys.

sampleQueries.description: Alert on USB removable storage devices ONLINE events
Which users are writing files to removable storage devices
sampleQueries.query: secRMM_CL | where Event_s == 'WRITE COMPLETED' | summarize count() by User_s

sampleQueries.description: Microsoft BitLocker Activity for removable storage devices
Microsoft Windows Defender Activity for removable storage devices
Hardware Encrypted Device Activity
sampleQueries.query: secRMM_CL | where DeviceDescription_s contains ' ENCRYPTED Removable Media'

sampleQueries.description: Users who have tried to execute macros or programs from a removable storage device
sampleQueries.query: secRMM_CL | where ((Event_s == 'BLOCK MACROS ON DEVICE ACTIVE') or (Event_s == 'BLOCK PROGRAMS ON DEVICE ACTIVE')) | summarize count() by User_s

sampleQueries.description: Removable storage devices that are not encrypted (hardware or software)
Removable storage devices that are mounted into a Virtual Machine (from physical)
sampleQueries.query: secRMM_CL | where ((Event_s == 'EXTERNAL') and (Message_s contains 'ONLINE') and (Message_s contains 'Virtual Machine'))

sampleQueries.description: Removable storage devices that are mounted into a Virtual Machine (from virtual)
Show mobile devices that are being USB mounted
Show mobile devices that are being USB mounted but are not MDM (Microsoft Intune) enrolled
sampleQueries.query: secRMM_CL | where ((Event_s == 'ONLINE') and (AdditionalProgramInfo_s contains 'Mobile device is not MDM enrolled'))

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create the Azure resources and grant the required permissions
instructionSteps.description: secRMM pushes its events to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated configuration and secure data ingestion with an Entra application
Clicking the button below creates the secRMM_CL Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR). It then creates a Microsoft Entra application, gives it permission to send data to the DCR, and creates a secret for it. secRMM uses this application to send its events securely to the DCR.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure secRMM to send its events to the workspace
instructionSteps.description: Enter the values below into secRMM's Azure Log Analytics (V2) settings on each computer running secRMM. See the [Squadra Technologies configuration guide for Microsoft Sentinel](https://www.squadratechnologies.com/StaticContent/ProductDownload/secRMM/9.11.0.0/secRMMAzureSentinelAdministratorGuide.pdf) for details.

properties.description: This workbook gives an overview of security data for removable storage activity such as USB thumb drives and USB connected mobile devices, with tabs for charts, all events, writes, online/offline, devices, authorization failures, administration changes, encryption, models and users.
Removable_Storage_ONLINE_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.3.0
Detect when a removable storage device is plugged in by the end-user.
properties.displayName: Removable storage ONLINE event from secRMM
properties.query:
secRMM_CL | where Event_s == "ONLINE" | 
extend AccountCustomEntity = User_s |
extend HostCustomEntity = Computer
